title: Winter Olympics: hosts and who topped the table
intro: Every Winter Games of the last twenty years and the next two: where they were held, and which country finished top of the medal table.
dataNote: Hosts and years are not in dispute anywhere. The medal figures are the finishing positions as recorded, with two exceptions flagged in the table itself: Sochi 2014, where Russia's totals were revised downward after the doping cases and sources still differ, and Pyeongchang 2018, where Norway and Germany tied on golds and the order depends on which tiebreak is applied.
